name: Li Shen
source:
"As the cosmos dances to the tune of eternity, life will reach the fathomless depths of Deepspace."
"Sleep. We'll meet again when dawn greets the world once more."

The heroine's primacy physician, recommended by her grandma. An unflappable, one of the Akso hospital's top cardiac surgeon. tasked to keep an eye on the heroine's heart condition. 
As the youngest recipient of the Starcatcher Award, he has contributed to lowering the prevalence of congenital heart defects in newborns with his discovery that Evol genes affect the mutation rate of cells during heart development.

[Taken from [URL=https://twitter.com/Love_Deepspace/status/1722090003508174974/]Official Twitter account[/URL]]
